facts.big: there was / there were · ate · came
facts.label: Passado e there was/were
facts.sub: Use there was com uma coisa e there were com várias. Conte o passado com ate, came, cooked e did: What did you eat? There was corn.

facts.label: There was / There were
facts.sub: Para falar do passado, use there was com uma coisa e there were com várias: There was a pie. There were potatoes. Com there were, os nomes ficam no plural.

facts.label: Passado simples
facts.sub: Verbos regulares ganham -ed: cooked, talked, played. Verbos irregulares mudam: eat vira ate, come vira came, have vira had. Aprenda esses verbos como itens separados.
